approval_requests_subject_match.name: approval_requests_subject_match
approval_requests_subject_match.value:
(("approval_requests"."subject_type" = 'leave_request') = ("approval_requests"."leave_request_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("approval_requests"."subject_type" = 'attendance_correction') = ("approval_requests"."attendance_correction_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("approval_requests"."subject_type" = 'reimbursement_claim') = ("approval_requests"."reimbursement_claim_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("approval_requests"."subject_type" = 'profile_change') = ("approval_requests"."profile_change_request_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("approval_requests"."subject_type" = 'payroll_run') = ("approval_requests"."payroll_run_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("approval_requests"."subject_type" = 'payroll_adjustment') = ("approval_requests"."payroll_adjustment_id" IS NOT NULL))

approval_steps_approver.name: approval_steps_approver
approval_steps_approver.value: "approval_steps"."approver_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "approval_steps"."approver_permission" IS NOT NULL

approval_steps_decided.name: approval_steps_decided
approval_steps_decided.value: "approval_steps"."decision" = 'pending' OR ("approval_steps"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_steps"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

attendance_corrections_has_time.name: attendance_corrections_has_time
attendance_corrections_has_time.value: "attendance_corrections"."proposed_check_in_at" IS NOT NULL OR "attendance_corrections"."proposed_check_out_at" IS NOT NULL

attendance_events_reason.name: attendance_events_reason
attendance_events_reason.value: "attendance_events"."type" NOT IN ('manual_entry', 'correction') OR "attendance_events"."reason" IS NOT NULL

attendance_events_order.name: attendance_events_order
attendance_events_order.value: "attendance_events"."check_out_at" IS NULL OR "attendance_events"."check_in_at" IS NULL OR "attendance_events"."check_out_at" > "attendance_events"."check_in_at"

documents_dates.name: documents_dates
documents_dates.value: "documents"."expiry_date" IS NULL OR "documents"."issue_date" IS NULL OR "documents"."expiry_date" >= "documents"."issue_date"

documents_deleted_fields.name: documents_deleted_fields
documents_deleted_fields.value: "documents"."status" <> 'deleted' OR ("documents"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."deleted_reason" IS NOT NULL)

employees_separation_after_joining.name: employees_separation_after_joining
employees_separation_after_joining.value: "employees"."separation_date" IS NULL OR "employees"."joining_date" IS NULL OR "employees"."separation_date" >= "employees"."joining_date"

leave_ledger_request_ref.name: leave_ledger_request_ref
leave_ledger_request_ref.value: "leave_ledger_entries"."type" NOT IN ('reservation', 'reservation_release', 'usage', 'reversal') OR "leave_ledger_entries"."leave_request_id" IS NOT NULL

leave_ledger_sign.name: leave_ledger_sign
leave_ledger_sign.value: ("leave_ledger_entries"."type" IN ('reservation', 'usage', 'expiry') AND "leave_ledger_entries"."amount" < 0) OR ("leave_ledger_entries"."type" IN ('grant', 'accrual', 'reservation_release', 'reversal', 'carry_forward') AND "leave_ledger_entries"."amount" > 0) OR "leave_ledger_entries"."type" = 'adjustment'

leave_requests_half_day.name: leave_requests_half_day
leave_requests_half_day.value: "leave_requests"."unit" = 'day' OR ("leave_requests"."start_date" = "leave_requests"."end_date" AND "leave_requests"."half_day_part" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."requested_units" = 0.5)

reimbursement_claims_payroll_ref.name: reimbursement_claims_payroll_ref
reimbursement_claims_payroll_ref.value: "reimbursement_claims"."status" NOT IN ('included', 'paid') OR "reimbursement_claims"."payroll_item_id" IS NOT NULL
